trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Deployed v2.3.2 to all production regions** (us-east, us-west, eu-west), replacing v2.3.1, which was unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Since v2.3.2 had no prior production history, the deployment was routed for change-manager approval per policy, and it was approved and rolled out successfully.
2. **Opened SEV3 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api documenting the hotfix deployment, the replacement of unhealthy v2.3.1, and the approval. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: The service was unhealthy before the hotfix; I'd recommend watching the error rate to confirm v2.3.2 restores health.
